name: instructions-audit
description: A prompt-injection tripwire for instruction files. Audits CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/*.md content and flags hidden or hostile directives: invisible Unicode smuggling (zero width characters, tag characters, variation-selector runs; the TrapDoor supply-chain signature), bidi overrides, directives to read or exfiltrate secrets, curl|sh, decode-and-execute, and hook/settings tampering. Files that load during a session are audited by an InstructionsLoaded hook. The files read at session start load before plugin hooks register, so the first UserPromptSubmit or PreToolUse of each session audits them (with their @ imports) before the model acts. A finding locks the session and every prompt and tool call is denied until a human fixes the file or clears the named lock. Tune via HOOK_AUDIT_LEVEL (critical/high/strict) and HOOK_AUDIT_WARN_ONLY, no file edits needed.
